host.title: Host
host.description: The full connection URL of your MongoDB database.

database_includes.title: List of databases to include
database_includes.description: A list of databases names to include in the discovery process. If this list is empty, all databases available on your MongoDB instance will be included.

batch_size.title: Batch size
batch_size.description: The number of documents to fetch in a single batch. Setting this to a smaller number helps reduce the overload on the system, although the extraction time will be higher.

cursor_timeout.title: Cursor timeout (minutes)
cursor_timeout.description: Server-side cursor timeout in minutes. Set to 0 to disable timeout, which prevents CursorNotFound errors on long-running syncs. Note: 0 is not supported on Atlas free/shared tiers. When not set, uses MongoDB's server default (10 minutes).

max_parallel_streams.title: Max parallel streams
max_parallel_streams.description: The number of streams to sync in parallel. Defaults to 1 (sequential). Increasing this value can significantly reduce total extraction time for pipelines with many collections.

max_size.title: Max batch size for parquet files
